commands.label: Run the official Opal compiler on the exact language input with a headless browser API bridge
Run the official Opal compiler on the exact language input with a headless browser API bridge

browser_bridge.rb.content_utf8:
require 'opal/raw'

module Kernel
  def alert(message)
    Opal::Raw.call(:alert, message)
  end
end

toolchain: Official Opal 1.8.3 Ruby-to-JavaScript compiler and headless Node.js
reproduction_command: opal -I . -r browser_bridge --compile hello.opal > greeting.js; node check.js
semantic_scope: For the Ruby-to-JavaScript dialect used by the referenced Linguist sample, Opal compiled the corpus source to JavaScript. The compiled code called the browser alert bridge with the exact greeting, which the headless host captured as text.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
